_: Finger tab: an 8 mm plate that runs from inside the case, through a front-wall slot and a carrier window, to be fixed to the carrier (a cross pin, not modelled). Two per finger, one under the linear block and one over it (z0 by params), and the finger pivot pin spans both, so each link sits in double shear between them. Local x 0 is the block centre xf; the pin is at −inset. side = 1 right, -1 left. One extrude along +Z.
